title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. However, if the regularization parameter is too high, it can lead to underfitting, increasing the model's bias.

title: Effect of Decreasing Regularization
text: Decreasing the regularization hyperparameter reduces the penalty on model complexity, allowing the model to fit the training data more closely. This can help reduce bias but may increase variance.

title: Impact on Model Bias
text: What happens to the model bias when you decrease the regularization hyperparameter?
choices: The model bias remains the same.

title: Balancing Bias and Variance
text: While decreasing regularization can reduce bias, it's important to monitor the model's variance. A balance between bias and variance is crucial for optimal model performance.
